Class ClientProxy

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.CommonProxy
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.ClientProxy
public final class ClientProxy extends CommonProxy
Client-side proxy handling client-only initialization, event subscriptions, and lifecycle hooks.

Instantiated only by the CLIENT side of @SidedProxy.
